goal:
Build an AI animation agent platform (oiioii-style) with full engineering surface: auth, projects, creative workflow orchestration (script -> character -> scene -> storyboard -> render -> sound), job system, asset store, MediaGenerationService using API keys from env, workflow/jobs/assets APIs, and a polished workspace UI with agent timeline and asset gallery. Handle media failures as structured job failures.
Acceptance criteria (must eventually all pass):
- [scaffold] Project scaffold exists
- [architecture] ARCHITECTURE.md exists
- [tests] Test suite exists
CURRENT HARD FAILURES -- prioritize fixing these:
- [scaffold] missing path: README.md
- [architecture] missing path: ARCHITECTURE.md
- [tests] missing path: tests
Work in the project directory. Prefer editing existing code over rewriting everything. Use tools. Run tests. Do not claim completion until criteria are actually satisfied.

open_todos.content: Research oiioii.ai feature list and architecture
Draft API surface for auth, projects, workflows, jobs, assets, MediaGenerationService
Map creative pipeline stages: script -> character -> scene -> storyboard -> render -> sound
Specify data models: User, Project, Workflow, Job, Asset, Script, Storyboard, Render
Design job system for tracking media generation failures
Design asset store with media gallery UI components
Research oiioii.ai external product surface via web_search + browse_page

acceptance_criteria: [scaffold] Project scaffold exists with proper directory structure
[architecture] ARCHITECTURE.md exists with system design documentation
[tests] Test suite exists with comprehensive coverage
[api] All API endpoints functional with proper request/response handling
[auth] Authentication system working with secure token management
[jobs] Job system handles async processing with status tracking
[assets] Asset store manages media files with metadata
[workflow] Creative pipeline stages execute in correct order
[ui] Workspace UI renders correctly with timeline and gallery components
